title: Sabbatical Cottage Seaside, FL
meta_description: Sabbatical is a 3 BR / 3 BA / 10 Guest cottage in Seaside, FL. Fitting name, isn’t it? If you’re coming to Seaside on a Sabbatical, there’s no better choice than ‘Sabbatical.’ This heavenly white cottage is the perfect place to unwind and de-stress from a period of hard work.
description_expanded: Description14 WEST RUSKIN STREET1 KING, 2 QUEENS, 2 QUEEN SLEEPER SOFAS - Sleeps 10Prime Beachfront Location in Seaside, FloridaSabbatical offers an exceptional Seaside beach rental experience with an unbeatable location directly across from the beach at West Ruskin Pavilion, just a one-minute walk from the sugar-white sand and Gulf waters. Ideally situated only one block from downtown Seaside’s Amphitheater, this home places more than 35 shops, restaurants, and entertainment venues within easy walking distance—perfect for guests who want to experience the best of Seaside, Florida without ever needing to drive.Inviting Porches with Gulf ViewsGuests arrive to a private driveway with parking for one vehicle, along with additional parking available directly in front of the home. Two expansive open-air porches span the length of the house, creating inviting outdoor living spaces on both levels. The upper porch boasts stunning Gulf views, while the first-floor porch features Adirondack seating for two and a bench swing—an ideal spot to enjoy morning coffee while listening to the waves just across the street.Spacious Living & Entertaining AreasInside, the first floor welcomes guests with a large, open living room offering generous seating for family and friends. A queen sleeper sofa provides accommodations for additional guests, while multiple club chairs encourage relaxed conversation. The living area also includes a large flat-screen TV with soundbar, perfect for movie nights after a full day at the beach.Comfortable Guest Bedrooms with Ensuite BathsThe first floor features two queen bedrooms, each with its own private ensuite bathroom. One bedroom offers wall-mounted nautical reading lights, a small closet, flat-screen TV, and a recently renovated bathroom with a glass-enclosed walk-in shower and large single vanity. The second queen bedroom mirrors these comforts with its own flat-screen TV, closet, and newly updated private bath featuring a glass-enclosed walk-in shower and spacious vanity.Upstairs Kitchen, Dining & Sunset PorchUpstairs, the open-concept kitchen and dining area lead seamlessly to another expansive open-air porch. The kitchen is beautifully appointed with sleek black stone countertops, a breakfast bar seating four, and all-new stainless steel appliances, including a double oven, induction cooktop, large double-door refrigerator, microwave, and dishwasher. The adjacent dining area features a farmhouse table that comfortably seats six. Just beyond, the favorite open-air porch offers al fresco dining, Adirondack seating for six, and breathtaking Gulf and sunset views—the perfect setting for evening cocktails.Luxurious Primary Suite RetreatAdjacent to the upstairs living areas, the primary king suite provides a peaceful retreat. This expansive space includes a comfortable seating area with a queen sleeper sofa, two club chairs, and a large flat-screen TV. Two spacious closets and a dedicated desk make this suite ideal for extended stays or remote work. A wall of windows fills the room with natural light and lively Seaside views. The ensuite bathroom features a soaker tub with shower combination, offering a relaxing end to beach-filled days.Thoughtful Amenities for a Relaxing StayAdditional amenities include a full-size laundry room with washer and dryer and a private outdoor shower for rinsing off after time at the beach. With its unbeatable location, generous porches, and thoughtfully designed interiors, Sabbatical is a true Seaside gem—offering the perfect blend of coastal charm, comfort, and convenience for an unforgettable vacation in Seaside, Florida.Need more room? Sabbatical can sleep an additional four in the guest cottage Dreamboat.* 7-night Saturday to Saturday minimum Summer, 5-night minimum Spring & Spring Break; 3-night minimum for Fall; 2-night minimum Winter. Must be 25 years of age to rent and sign the registration. FEATURESFeatures 2,362 square feet1-minute walk, 285 feet to beach accessSeaside Private Residential Beach at West Ruskin Pavilion; the largest private beach on 30APrivate driveway parkingPorch swingSmart TVs throughout the home; TVs in every bedroomPeacock Alley Linens – Fresh and luxurious Peacock Alley towels and sheets throughout the homeAccess to 3 swimming pools, 5 Clay tennis courts & 3 Pickleball courts (court fees apply), and a fitness centerWelcome tote with 2 beach towels, a complimentary bottle of wine, and 2 complimentary rental bikes for pickup at the Seaside Transit AuthorityPersonalized service throughout your stay with starter amenities provided2 parking passes are issued. A golf cart is considered a car. Golf carts for non-homeowners visiting Seaside are prohibited. Special circumstances and medical needs requests require a golf cart permitNo pets allowedSTR23-002297
